constraints_for_code_generation.description: Design constraints and validation rules for code generation and model variation

constraints.name: Mounting hole diameter tolerance
constraints.reason: Must accommodate M3 bolts with sufficient clearance for assembly
constraints.enforcement: Validate after generation: measure holes in test print
constraints.risk_if_violated: Bolts won't fit or will be too loose, assembly fails
constraints.mitigation: Add 0.2mm to hole diameter for FDM shrinkage if needed

constraints.name: Wall thickness at thin sections
constraints.reason: Must support 20kg load without permanent deformation
constraints.enforcement: Measure walls in test print with calipers
constraints.risk_if_violated: Bracket flexes excessively or fails under load
constraints.mitigation: Increase infill percentage if walls too thin in print

constraints.name: External corner radius tolerance
constraints.risk_if_violated: Sharper corners may fail under stress
constraints.mitigation: If corners too sharp, increase radius parameter

constraints.name: Minimum wall thickness
constraints.reason: Below this, PLA parts fail under 20kg sustained load
constraints.test_criteria: Load test: 20kg weight applied for 24 hours without visible deformation

constraints.name: Hole diameter minimum
constraints.reason: Printer nozzle limits and M3 bolt clearance
constraints.risk_if_violated: Holes don't print or bolt won't fit
constraints.test_criteria: Bolt insertion test: M3 bolt slides smoothly through hole

constraints.name: Overall bracket stiffness
constraints.implementation: RibHeight >= 3mm and ribs spaced at BaseWidth * 0.25
constraints.test_criteria: Vertical deflection < 5mm under 20kg load at bracket span

constraints.name: Minimum feature size
constraints.applies_to: All edges, holes, and thin features
constraints.risk_if_violated: Features don't print or print unreliably

constraints.name: Minimum fillet radius
constraints.reason: Sharper radii cause print failures due to sharp corners
constraints.enforcement: Code validation: all internal fillets >= 1.0mm, external >= CornerRadius
constraints.risk_if_violated: Sharp corners fail and crack during/after printing

constraints.name: Overhang angle limit
constraints.reason: Overhangs steeper than 45° require support structures
constraints.enforcement: Geometry check: ensure no overhangs > 45° on model surfaces
constraints.mitigation: If overhangs present, use tree supports

constraints.name: Bridge length limit
constraints.reason: Bridges longer than 10mm tend to sag or break
constraints.applies_to: Any horizontal feature spanning across gaps
constraints.mitigation: Reduce support structure removal or add internal supports

constraints.name: Mounting hole position rule
constraints.rule: All four mounting holes MUST be positioned exactly in corners with 10mm inset
constraints.enforcement: Hardcoded in code generation - no parameter
constraints.why_not_parameterized: Corner holes must align with post connector holes (fixed standard)

constraints.name: Base depth fixed
constraints.why_not_parameterized: Must match aluminum post standard spacing

constraints.name: Mounting boss height relationship
constraints.why_relationship: Boss scales proportionally with bracket width

constraints.name: Wall taper factor fixed
constraints.why_not_parameterized: Specific design decision for this model

constraints.name: Rib extension limit
constraints.rule: Reinforcement ribs extend to 80% of width (20mm margin at edges)
constraints.why_rule: Prevents ribs interfering with edge mounting areas

constraints.name: Width affects boss height
constraints.implication: Increasing width also increases boss height
constraints.code_handling: Derived automatically - no user input needed

constraints.name: Width affects rib spacing
constraints.code_handling: Derived automatically - no user input needed

constraints.name: Hole diameter affects hole spacing
constraints.relationship: Hole positions fixed at corners but inset = min(10, BaseWidth * 0.1)
constraints.implication: Very narrow widths get different hole positions
constraints.enforcement: Validate: minimum width must be 50mm (allows 10mm inset on all sides)

constraints.name: Wall thickness affects rib prominence
constraints.relationship: Thin walls (1.5mm) = more prominent ribs needed
constraints.note: Not enforced by code but documented for user understanding

constraints.name: Width variation
constraints.recommendation: All variations use single parameterized script - change BaseWidth only

qa_checks.code: Measure model cross-section, verify walls >= MinWallThickness

CRITICAL.description: Violating these constraints will result in model failure or non-functionality
CRITICAL.recovery: Reject code generation and inform user with specific error message

HIGH.description: Violating these will likely cause issues but model may still function
HIGH.recovery: Warn user and suggest parameter adjustment

MEDIUM.description: Violating these may cause minor issues or require post-processing
MEDIUM.recovery: Log warning, allow generation but document issue
